abstract: Covers JOSE and JWT issuing and verification: RFC 7515 to RFC 7519, RFC 8037 OKP keys, the RFC 8725 JWT Best Current Practices with its rfc8725bis update (-10, build posture), RFC 9864 fully specified algorithms, RFC 9964 ML-DSA signatures with AKP keys, the none and RSA1_5 deprecation draft (-06, build posture), HPKE for JWE (-22, build posture), PQ/T composite signatures (-04, track posture), JSON Web Proof (-14, track posture), RFC 9068 JWT access tokens with roles, groups and entitlements, RFC 7638 thumbprints, the RFC 7800 cnf claim, and the IANA JOSE and JWT claims registries. The published JOSE RFCs are the current line; rfc8725bis, the none and RSA1_5 deprecation and HPKE for JWE are build-posture previews, composite signatures and JSON Web Proof are tracked, with an RFC 8725 to rfc8725bis verifier upgrade. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out the version lines, the verification checklist, algorithms and keys, and access tokens with the claims registry.
